Brief Question Summary: Transform string of length n into an alternating string where all characters at even positions are identical, and all at odd positions are identical. If n is odd, you can delete at most 1 character.

2. If n is odd: precalculate prefix and suffix frequencies for both parities. Iterate i from 0 to n-1: pretend deleting char at i, merge prefix parity counts with flipped suffix parity counts. Pick min operations.
3. Operations count includes +1 for the deleted character.

Brief Question Summary: Given an array of 0s and 1s, flip at most k zeros to ones to maximize the length of contiguous ones.
Core Intuition: Sliding window / Two pointers DP: maintain a window [L, R] containing at most k zeros. When zeros count exceeds k, advance L. The maximum window size achieved gives the longest contiguous block of 1s.

5. Reconstruct array by setting a[best_L .. best_L + best_len - 1] to 1.
